availability_note: Same Sootopolis party (Rillaboom 36, Raging Bolt 60, Kartana 20, Flutter Mane 68, Incineroar 36, Zapdos 30 reachable legend); Sootopolis after the cavern and Cave of Origin, Rain Badge not earned, nothing from Ever Grande or the League.

attempts.note: T1 Palafin Protect blocked Fake Out + Thunderbolt; Barraskewda swapped to Azumarill. T2 Grassy Glide + Thunderclap (both priority) KOed Palafin before its chosen Flip Turn resolved - Hero Form never happened; Azumarill Belly Drummed. T3 Azumarill clicked Belly Drum again at +6 (failed) while Glide did 245; Barraskewda swapped to Greninja. T4 Glide finished Azumarill before Play Rough, Draco Meteor broke Inteleon's Sash on the switch-in. T5 Greninja switched into a 2x Glide and died. T6 Thunderclap took the 16-HP Inteleon and a crit Wood Hammer took the Aqua Jet-locked Barraskewda. T7 Mega Kingler's X-Scissor KOed Rillaboom (201); T8 Protect; T9 Leaf Blade ended it.

strategy_checks.check: Palafin Flip Turn / hard switch only with a healthy receiver, becoming Hero Form on re-entry
strategy_checks.evidence: T1 Protect; T2 chose Flip Turn with five healthy receivers, but two priority attacks (Grassy Glide under terrain, Thunderclap) resolved first and it fainted at 288 HP. Hero Form never appeared - the crack line ('kill Palafin before it leaves') working as written.

strategy_checks.check: Barraskewda Propeller Tail attacks beside Palafin
strategy_checks.evidence: It was withdrawn on T1 and T3 (both times for a fresh body) and attacked only on T5-T6 with Band-locked Aqua Jet (24 into a resisting Rillaboom) before a crit Wood Hammer took it. Propeller Tail never mattered because I had no redirection out.

strategy_checks.check: Azumarill Belly Drum admitted only after a survival check, then Aqua Jet
strategy_checks.evidence: T2 Belly Drum at full HP with Sitrus (survival check plausible: my Electric/Grass attackers were both resisted or neutral on it). T3 it chose Belly Drum AGAIN at +6 and the move failed; T4 Play Rough was selected but priority Glide KOed it first. The +6 Aqua Jet was never used.

Greninja was switched in twice and never moved (OHKOed by 2x Glide on the second entry). Inteleon hung on its Sash to Draco Meteor, was withdrawn, re-entered and fired one Ice Beam (115 on Rillaboom) before Thunderclap took it.
T7 Mega Evolved and X-Scissor (2x, correct pick over Crabhammer into a Grass type) KOed Rillaboom from 200; T8 Protect blocked Leaf Blade + Thunderbolt; T9 died.

protect_ledger.payoff: REAL - blocked Fake Out + 2x Thunderbolt; partner slot switched Barraskewda for Azumarill.
REAL - blocked a lethal Leaf Blade + Thunderbolt; bought one turn with no partner.

ai_defects.board: Azumarill (+6 Atk, ~277 HP) + Barraskewda vs Rillaboom + Raging Bolt
ai_defects.chosen: Belly Drum (already at +6; the move failed)
ai_defects.better: Aqua Jet or Play Rough - at +6 Huge Power either KOs. A stat move whose stat is already maximised must be excluded; this wasted the one turn the Drum had bought and the Glide that followed killed it. High severity for this room's concept.

ai_defects.chosen: five hard switches in six turns, twice feeding a frail body into a visible 2x attack (Greninja into Glide, Inteleon into Draco Meteor)
ai_defects.better: Attack with the Band lead; the switch carousel gave me free priority KOs. Medium severity; same receiver-choice pattern as Olivia (298) and Tiffany (299).

authored_set_legality: No problem found. Levels L84 x5, Kingler L85. Note Palafin's Flip Turn was chosen on T2 with reserves available, as the dossier requires.
theme_note: Partly. The speed-and-priority idea is visible (Palafin's pivot attempt, Belly Drum, Aqua Jet lock, Mega Kingler's KO), but the memorable moment - meeting Hero Form - is exactly what the crack line prevents and my own priority did prevent it. The Belly Drum repeat is the one thing that made the room feel broken rather than beaten.

level_changes.reason: first-try 6-1 with no real threat; switched in twice and never moved.
one Ice Beam in eight turns; Palafin/Azumarill are the concept and Kingler the Mega.

level_changes_unverified: Not re-run: build-8 ROM predates these offsets; rerun after the main agent rebuilds.
cooler: Yes, cheaply: give Palafin a Focus Sash instead of Leftovers so the Flip Turn always survives one priority volley and Hero Form is actually met; and fix the Belly Drum repeat on the AI side. Not changed in this pass.
most_worth_rerunning: Rerun to confirm the Belly Drum-at-+6 repeat and to see whether a Sash-less Palafin ever reaches Hero Form against a non-priority lead.
